summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a share buyback program that commenced on April 24, 2026. The program acquired 3,581,623 common shares at an average price of KRW 167,522 per share, for a total of KRW 600 billion. The acquired shares represent 1.01% of total shares outstanding (354,687,734 shares). The acquisition settled on July 16, 2026 (T+2 basis). This is a capital return event via open-market share repurchase. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is applicable. The filing is routine for a completed buyback; no pending regulatory clock or risk-arb angle exists. Monitoring future buyback announcements would be relevant.
